title: console(marketplace): the 「更新」 button opens a dialog that says 「安装」, names no versions, gives no notice of a major upgrade, and offers 「包含示例数据」 unexplained; the package description prints raw README HTML
body:
Seen in the console on 2026-10-11, on the staging environment `os-4s63kc`, while upgrading HotCRM 3.1.0 → 4.0.1 from Setup → 应用市场 → HotCRM. The detail page read 「已安装 · v3.1.0」 and 「有可用更新 → v4.0.1」. ## 1. The 「更新」 button opens an install dialog Clicking 「更新」 opens a dialog that: - is titled 「安装 HotCRM」, with the subtitle 「安装到当前环境（os-4s63kc.objectos.app）。」; - offers the checkbox 「包含示例数据」; - has the primary button 「安装」 (「安装中…」 while it runs); - reports 「安装成功。打开环境即可看到新应用。」 when done. What is wrong with that: - **The wording is install, not update.** A user who clicked 「更新」 reads 「安装」 and cannot tell whether a second copy is about to be installed. - **No versions are named.** The dialog does not say from-version → to-version (3.1.0 → 4.0.1). - **The jump is a major version, with no notice.** HotCRM 4.0 changes the contact address field, and its release notes call for a one-time conversion (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2062). The dialog says nothing, and the version notes sit only in the side panel. - **The 「包含示例数据」 checkbox is unexplained on an update.** What does it do to an environment that already holds data? **Expected:** - an update dialog titled 「更新 HotCRM」 that names `3.1.0 → 4.0.1`; - when the major version changes, one line saying so, linking to the version's release notes; - the sample-data checkbox either hidden on an update or explained; - a primary button 「更新」, and the result 「已更新到 4.0.1」. ## 2. The package description prints raw HTML as text On the same page, the 简介 block begins with the README's raw HTML shown as literal text: ```

``` Not rendering a package's raw HTML is right, because it is third-party content. But printing it is noise, and the relative `assets/icon.svg` would not resolve anyway. **Expected:** drop raw-HTML blocks from the rendered description, neither rendering nor printing them. Reader: the console marketplace face (`apps/console`, marketplace package detail). --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
